title: Lumber Tycoon
description: Build your automated timber empire! Explore 6 rich forest biomes, chop lush trees, haul stacked logs, process timber at the sawmill for bonuses, upgrade axes and backpacks, and hire a crew of automated lumberjack bots in this cozy top-down tycoon arcade.
howToPlay: Use WASD or touch virtual joystick to move freely. Stand near trees to auto-chop logs. Collect fallen logs in your backpack and deliver them to the Sawmill (+50% value) or Wood Market. Upgrade your axes and backpack at the shop, hire automated workers, and unlock new forest biomes!
